# Perplexity.ai Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/perplexity-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/perplexity-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects data from perplexity.ai, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Perplexity AI in 2026](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-perplexity)
- **Code:** [`perplexity.py`](perplexity.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Answer](results/answer.json)

## What it scrapes

- Answer pages: query, answer markdown, cited domains, source count, follow-up suggestions

## Functions

- `scrape_answer(prompt)` → `PerplexityAnswer`: Single-turn: ask one prompt on perplexity.ai in Scrapfly's cloud browser and parse the answer

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import perplexity


async def main():
    answer = await perplexity.scrape_answer("How does photosynthesis work")


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields:

- **`PerplexityAnswer`**: `query`, `answer_markdown`, `cited_domains`, `source_count`, `follow_ups`

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`perplexity.py`](perplexity.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `proxy_pool` = `"residential"`: proxy pool (datacenter or residential)
- `country` = `"US"`: country of the proxy
- `os` = `"macos"`: operating system of the browser
- `cache` = `True`: use Scrapfly's response cache

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/perplexity-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_scrape_answer`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
